sources.title: Qwen3-8B - Qualcomm AI Hub
sources.snippet: Qwen3-8B State‑of‑the‑art large language model useful on a variety of language understanding and generation tasks. The Qwen3‑8B is a state‑of‑the‑art multilingual base language model with 8 billion parameters, excelling in language understanding, generation, coding, and mathematics.

sources.title: Qwen3.8-Flash-Next - GitHub
sources.snippet: Qwen3.8-Flash-Next upgrades the model systematically along four aspects — attention, residual, embedding and optimization — improving model capability while further optimizing computational efficiency, model capacity and training stability: Attention A GDN + QSA hybrid architecture.

sources.title: GitHub - AlibabaCloud-Official/Qwen3.8-27B: Native multimodal dense LLM ...
sources.snippet: Welcome to the repository for Qwen3.8-27B —the latest native multimodal dense open-weight model released by Alibaba's Qwen team. Delivering top-tier performance for local hardware, Qwen3.8-27B excels at coding, agentic workflows, and office automation tasks.

sources.title: qwen/qwen3-8b • LM Studio
sources.snippet: Qwen3 8B by qwen Supports a context length of up to 131,072 tokens with YaRN (default 32k) Supports /no_think to disable reasoning, just add it at the end of your prompt Supports both thinking and non-thinking modes withe enhanced reasoning in both for significantly enhanced mathematics, coding, and commonsense Excels at creative writing, role-playing, multi-turn dialogues, and instruction ...
